title: AuthorDeclareFunctionalParams
description:
`author.declare_functional` params: declare a predicate single-valued.

This stages a `Decl::Functional`, marking `pred` a functional dependency —
each subject may carry at most one certain value for it, so two distinct
certain values are a contradiction (`continuity.fd-violation`). It lets an
author judge a *first-seen* predicate single-valued, which canon precedent
alone cannot (issue 49, sub-claim 4; contract 1.6.0).

Provenance.description:
Provenance supplied when adding authored material. Internally tagged on
`kind`; origin tracking is load-bearing for Door T (nothing an agent supplies
mints authority).

oneOf.description: Cited to one or more decisions: `{"kind":"cited","decisions":["D-0104"]}`.

decisions.description: The cited decision identifiers in the consuming repo's ledger.

state.description: The requested standing on contract 1.5 and above.

origin.description: The origin token of the proposal (e.g. an agent session id).

hyp.description: The hypothesis the material is conditioned on.

ProvenanceState.description:
The stored standing requested for a cited authoring operation.

The field is optional here so pre-1.5 wire frames remain decodable. The
1.5 request boundary requires it for `kind: cited`.
